title: Transitions and effects
purpose: Lists every transition and overlay effect with type, duration and sync, and expresses the reusable ones as ffmpeg-reproducible recipes.
boundary: The swarm lifts technique and structure only. Never store, transcribe or reuse the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text. Keyframes and spectrograms are temporary analysis files in a scratch directory and are never copied into the format IR or a variant. On-screen text may be quoted only as a locating note in evidence.note, at most 6 words, and narration is never quoted. Patterns replace content words with slots, e.g. 'FACT {n}' or '{number} {unit} {noun}'. Analysing a public video for technique is fine; republishing its content is not.
inspect: F8 frame steps across each boundary (0.25 s either side); F11 scene scores for dissolves; A1 with highpass for whooshes.
pitfalls: Calling a hard cut a transition because the next shot zooms
Counting compression flicker as a flash
Inventing an xfade name that ffmpeg does not have

methods.measured: A measurement tool produced the value (an evidence.json field or an ffmpeg/ffprobe filter output). Name the tool and the field.
methods.observed: You looked at extracted frames, crops, scopes, spectrograms or waveforms and saw it. Give the timestamps you looked at.
methods.inferred: Reasoned from measured or observed facts, e.g. 'synthetic voice' from flat pitch on a spectrogram. State the reasoning in the note.
methods.assumed: No direct evidence; a default or convention. Use only for gaps the format needs filled, and keep confidence at 0.3 or lower.

pointer_conventions: ir_path is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the Video format IR (contract schema video_re_format_ir).
A final '/-' means 'append this answer to the array' (the RFC 6901 end-of-array token), e.g. /motion/transitions/- or /generation_rules/-.
A '*' segment means 'each array element the answer is about'; the answer must say which elements (for example beats with role 'item'). The lifter resolves '*' to concrete indexes.
Paths under free-form objects (typography.title, typography.captions, typography.labels, audio.narration, audio.music, render_binding.mapping) use the snake_case key named in the question.

answer_types.number: {"value": n, "unit": "..."} optionally with "min" and "max"; becomes an IR observed_number
answer_types.enum: exactly one of the question's choices (a string)
answer_types.list: array of short strings (technique names or kinds)
answer_types.timestamps: array of seconds from the start of the source
answer_types.rule: one procedural generation rule string, at most 400 characters, written in terms of parameters
answer_types.object: a JSON object with the keys the question's how_to_answer names

recipes.F2: Burst sheet, 10 frames over 1 s: ffmpeg -v error -ss T -t 1 -i "$SRC" -vf "fps=10,scale=270:-2,tile=5x2" -frames:v 1 "$WORK/burst_T.jpg"
recipes.F3: Full-resolution crop (add ,scale=iw*2:-1:flags=lanczos to enlarge): ffmpeg -v error -ss T -i "$SRC" -frames:v 1 -vf "crop=W:H:X:Y" "$WORK/crop_T.png"
recipes.F5: Per-frame motion in a region (mean absolute frame difference, 0-255): ffmpeg -v error -i "$SRC" -vf "crop=iw:ih*0.15:0:0,tblend=all_mode=difference,signalstats,metadata=mode=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG:file=$WORK/diff.txt" -an -f null -  (drop the crop for the full frame)
recipes.F6: Per-frame colour statistics (YMIN, YAVG, YMAX, SATAVG, HUEMED, UAVG, VAVG): ffmpeg -v error -ss T -t D -i "$SRC" -vf "signalstats,metadata=mode=print:file=$WORK/stats.txt" -an -f null -
recipes.F8: Every frame in a short window (animation timing; frame k is at T + k/fps): ffmpeg -v error -ss T -t 0.5 -i "$SRC" -vf "scale=540:-2" "$WORK/step_T_%03d.png"
recipes.F9: Average colour of a region: ffmpeg -v error -ss T -i "$SRC" -frames:v 1 -vf "crop=W:H:X:Y,scale=1:1:flags=area,format=rgb24" -f rawvideo - | od -An -tu1
recipes.F11: Per-frame scene-change score (finds dissolves and missed cuts): ffmpeg -v error -i "$SRC" -vf "select='gte(scene,0)',metadata=mode=print:key=lavfi.scene_score:file=$WORK/scene.txt" -an -f null -
recipes.F12: Black frames: ffmpeg -i "$SRC" -vf "blackdetect=d=0.05:pix_th=0.10" -an -f null - 2>&1 | grep black_
recipes.A1: Spectrogram image (add highpass=f=3000, before showspectrumpic to isolate clicks and whooshes): ffmpeg -v error -ss T -t D -i "$SRC" -lavfi "showspectrumpic=s=1200x600:legend=1" "$WORK/spec_T.png"

questions.question: Which transition types occur between shots (hard cut, dissolve, whip, zoom-through, slide, wipe, glitch, flash, dip to black, morph), with counts?
questions.why_it_matters: Fills motion.transitions with a weighted vocabulary.
questions.how_to_answer: For every shot boundary in evidence.shots[] (or a sample of 15), inspect F8 frame steps 0.25 s either side and F11 scene scores; classify each.
questions.challenge: Re-inspect 3 boundaries labelled as something other than hard cuts; each needs at least 2 intermediate frames.

questions.question: How long do non-cut transitions last (median ms, range)?
questions.how_to_answer: Count intermediate frames on F8 steps; ms = frames x 1000 / fps.
questions.challenge: Report frames and fps for each measured transition.

questions.question: Do transitions at item boundaries differ from transitions inside items?
questions.why_it_matters: Becomes separate rules for between-item and within-item transitions.
questions.how_to_answer: Compare transition types (001) at beat boundaries versus other boundaries.
questions.challenge: Report counts in both groups.

questions.question: How many white or colour flash frames are used, and how long is each?
questions.how_to_answer: F6 YAVG per frame: spikes of 1-3 frames; confirm on F8.
questions.challenge: Bright content cuts are not flashes; the flash frame must be near-uniform.

questions.question: Are zoom-through (scale-up into next shot) transitions used?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 across boundaries: outgoing shot scales up rapidly over 2+ frames before the new shot.
questions.challenge: A Ken Burns zoom ending at a cut is not a zoom transition unless it accelerates.

questions.question: Are glitch, RGB split or digital distortion effects used, and where?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 for horizontal displacement bands or colour channel offsets.
questions.challenge: Decoder errors look like glitches; they would also appear in a fresh decode only if in the file. Re-extract to confirm.

questions.question: Are light-leak or burn transitions used?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 across boundaries with warm bright washes covering the cut.
questions.challenge: Must cover the cut point, not appear mid-shot.

questions.question: What share of transitions have a whoosh or swish sound aligned with them (within 100 ms)?
questions.how_to_answer: A1 spectrograms with highpass=f=3000 around 6 transitions; look for rising or falling noise sweeps.
questions.challenge: Report the sample; music hi-hats are not whooshes.

questions.question: What share of transitions fall on a music onset (within 80 ms)?
questions.how_to_answer: Compare transition midpoints with evidence.audio.onsets_s.
questions.challenge: Compare with chance for the onset density.

questions.question: Do slides and wipes move in a consistent direction?
questions.how_to_answer: Record the direction of each slide or wipe from F8.
questions.challenge: Report counts per direction.

questions.question: Are shape or mask wipes used (circle, diagonal, brush, shape of an object)?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 across boundaries; describe the mask shape.
questions.challenge: Name the ffmpeg xfade transition that matches, if one exists (for example circleopen, wipeleft, diagtl).

questions.question: Are speed ramps used around transitions (shot accelerates into the cut)?
questions.how_to_answer: Compare motion speed in the last 0.3 s of a shot against earlier on F8.
questions.challenge: Report the speed change.

questions.question: Are there persistent overlay effects throughout (dust, scratches, scan lines, frame border)?
questions.how_to_answer: F2 bursts at 5 times across the video.
questions.challenge: Must appear at all 5 sampled times to be persistent.

questions.question: Is screen shake used on impacts or reveals, and how strong?
questions.how_to_answer: Track a fixed element over F8 at reveal moments.
questions.challenge: Report px amplitude and duration.

questions.question: Are freeze frames combined with an effect (desaturate, outline, label) to call out a moment?
questions.how_to_answer: F5 near-zero difference plus a visual change on F1.
questions.challenge: Stills with no motion are not freezes.

questions.question: Are particle bursts or confetti used on reveals?
questions.how_to_answer: F2 bursts at reveal times.
questions.challenge: Ambient particles present all the time are not bursts.

questions.question: Are blur transitions (defocus out, refocus in) used?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 across boundaries; sharpness drops then recovers.
questions.challenge: Compare edge sharpness on the frames (F3).

questions.question: What share of all shot changes use any transition effect at all?
questions.how_to_answer: From 001: non-cut transitions / all boundaries.
questions.challenge: Report the denominator.

questions.question: Are effects denser in the hook than in the body?
questions.how_to_answer: Effects per 10 s in the hook versus body.
questions.challenge: Report both rates.

questions.question: What happens at the very end (outro transition: fade, slide to end card, cut)?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 over the last 1.5 s.
questions.challenge: Cross-check with structure_beats-031.

questions.question: Which ffmpeg xfade transition and duration reproduce the main transition (for example fade 0.25 s, slideleft 0.3 s, circleopen 0.4 s)?
questions.why_it_matters: Gives the compiler a concrete, reproducible recipe.
questions.how_to_answer: Pick from xfade's built-in list (check ffmpeg -h filter=xfade) the closest match to 001; render a 2 s test with testsrc2 and compare frame steps.
questions.challenge: The named transition must exist in the installed ffmpeg; run the test render.

questions.question: Which transition parameters should a new video set (kinds and weights, duration, sfx coupling)?
questions.how_to_answer: Collect 001, 002 and 008.
questions.challenge: Each parameter needs derived_from.

questions.question: How many effect events (transitions, flashes, shakes, bursts) happen per minute?
questions.how_to_answer: Count all effect timestamps / duration x 60.
questions.challenge: Do not double-count an effect listed under two names.

questions.question: Do transitions cover jump cuts or continuity breaks (for example a flash placed on a jump cut)?
questions.why_it_matters: Adds a rule for when to use cover transitions.
questions.how_to_answer: Check whether transitions coincide with jump cuts found by pacing_cut_rhythm-017.
questions.challenge: If there are no jump cuts, answer not determinable.

questions.question: Are match or morph transitions used (shape in outgoing shot becomes shape in incoming shot)?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 across boundaries; look for aligned shapes that persist through the cut.
questions.challenge: Coincidental alignment must be ruled out; check the shapes are deliberately positioned.

questions.question: Do flash colours come from the palette (accent colour) or are they white?
questions.how_to_answer: F9 on flash frames.
questions.challenge: If there are no flashes, answer not determinable.

questions.question: Is a camera-flash or shutter effect used when photos appear?
questions.how_to_answer: F8 at photo appearances; A1 for a click.
questions.challenge: Requires both a brightness spike and a photo appearance.

questions.question: Are lens distortion or fisheye effects used?
questions.how_to_answer: F3 crops: straight lines bend near edges during effect moments.
questions.challenge: Wide-angle footage bends lines naturally; check graphics.

questions.question: Are transitions frame-clean (no stray single frames from the wrong shot at boundaries)?
questions.why_it_matters: A quality rule for the rebuild (avoid stray frames).
questions.how_to_answer: F8 at 10 boundaries; count stray frames.
questions.challenge: Report the boundaries checked.

questions.question: Do any effects pass over text and reduce its legibility?
questions.why_it_matters: Becomes a legibility rule (effects stay below text or avoid text moments).
questions.how_to_answer: F8 at effect moments where text is on screen.
questions.challenge: Name the moments.

questions.question: Are there dips to black or white between sections, and how long are they?
questions.how_to_answer: F12 blackdetect; F6 YMIN high for white dips.
questions.challenge: Exclude the first and last second.
